digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Friday, September 4, with six active calendar blocks, three urgent items, two carried-over tasks, and no active reminders. Use the morning opening and 11:30 AM focus block to settle the Amazon Connect calling-policy decisions, secure today's update on the dedicated Salesforce integration account, and confirm the Legal Guidance SOP and training path before the 1:00-3:30 PM meeting run. The main risk is that UAT Round 2 still has unresolved queue-transfer, language-prompt, integration-account, and business-control decisions ahead of Tuesday's kickoff, even though scripts and bug fixes are nearing completion.

items.label: Reconcile Asana with Armando's spreadsheet
items.detail: This operating-view cleanup has remained open across several briefings. Use the protected 11:30 AM block to close stale entries and leave one current source before the weekend.

items.label: Clarify the Toggl capacity model and escalation path
items.detail: The dedicated touchpoint was canceled and moved into the weekly team discussion. Document how capacity will be measured, who owns missing project IDs, and how the data will inform staffing so the decision does not drift into next week.

items.label: Morning through 10:30 AM - Open preparation window
items.detail: Use the clean morning runway for the calling-policy and integration-account decisions. The Salesforce Program Standup was canceled, removing the expected 10:30 AM conflict.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - SVC Daily Standup
items.detail: Bring the remaining Round 2 controls: queue transfer, language prompts, the integration account, attorney platform treatment, outbound caller ID, and number blocking.

items.label: 11:30 AM-1:00 PM - Protected focus block
items.detail: Finish the weekly executive update, reconcile Asana, and turn standup decisions into named owners before EPMO EOW.

items.label: 1:00-3:30 PM - EPMO EOW, training, pipeline sync, and slide update
items.detail: The 2:00 PM Spanish self-review training overlaps the 2:30 PM pipeline sync. Choose coverage deliberately and protect the 3:00 PM executive slide update.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect calling-policy path
items.detail: Decide whether new offices launch on Amazon Connect or RingCentral, confirm dynamic outbound caller-ID and callback-routing rules using Hilary's audit, and ask FirstFire to close the user-versus-queue number-blocking design. These controls need one business-approved path before solution design is finalized.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Nadia requested Tim's update today. Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created or routed through Halo, with the minimum permissions and monitoring needed to isolate an estimated 96,000 peak daily Voice API calls.

items.label: Decide the attorney calling-platform treatment
items.detail: Hilary's final roster leaves a leadership decision on whether attorneys join the contact center or remain in RingCentral. Put the item in the RAID log, choose the decision forum, and close the training-audience rule with the business.

items.label: Lock the Legal Guidance SOP and training path
items.detail: Jhara raised that next week's trainings may arrive before the SOPs, while Santiago is away until September 14. Confirm whether training can proceed first, set the SOP delivery owner, and alert Evan promptly if staffing changes the rollout date.

items.label: 8:00-9:00 AM - Approve timecards and prepare the week
items.detail: Use the early block to clear approvals and enter the week with the Tuesday Amazon Connect kickoff risks already assigned.

items.label: 10:30 AM-3:30 PM - Standup, focus time, portfolio review, and Maria 1:1
items.detail: SVC standup starts at 10:30 AM, followed by a noon focus block, the 2:00 PM BD portfolio review, and the 3:00 PM Maria 1:1. Keep the noon window protected for follow-through.
